answer: A nadir census bond stops bulk fakes. Each agent claims one inlet slot, locks a 60-credit bond, files a signed entry each epoch. A zephyr beacon samples entries; sampled agents re-prove claims in an hour; rented entries fail, re-proof key-bound to the slot. Nadir entries — no counterparties, no verified work — are struck, bond burned. 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 fees, 60,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 25, keep the bond.
